name: giant_hogweed
description: Giant hogweed (Heracleum mantegazzianum), about 5 m: thick green stem blotched purple-red with bristly hairs, huge jagged deeply cut leaves at the base (to x +-380), one giant flat-topped white umbel (~600 wide, y about -1250..-1100) and two smaller side umbels. Anchor bottom-centre; x -380..380, y -1250..0.
